items.text:
TLDR: Game Good, Much like. 11/10 would ram again.

>Be me.
>load in to first game.
>Bash thru door to get out of dimly lit Jail Cell.
>Nobody seems to care.
>walking thru the halls and spot a crowbar.
>proceed to Bash door to get to the crowbar.
*HeckYes.jpg*
>find ship *ahhh yesss*
>un-dock and figure out how to fly to ship graveyard and dock with another ship.
>enter ship... Of F*cK nO AiR... go back to ship.
>start flying back to OKLG station.
>Request docking but they tell me no...
*WhatWhyYouDoThis.png*
>read something about transponders on the internets.
>Mine seems to be good, in perfect working order...
>Ram into OKLG, and die...
>My face when I Realize I'm still docked with other ship...
items.text_zh:
长话短说：游戏好，很喜欢。11/10，还会再撞一次。

>是我。
>载入第一局游戏。
>砸开门冲出昏暗的牢房。
>似乎没人在意。
>穿过走廊，发现一根撬棍。
>继续砸门去拿那根撬棍。
*太棒了.jpg*
>找到飞船 *啊是的* 
>解除对接，摸索出怎么飞到飞船坟场并和另一艘飞船对接。
>进入飞船……卧槽没空气……回到自己船上。
>开始飞回OKLG空间站。
>请求对接，但他们拒绝了我……
*你为啥要这样.png*
>在网上读到一些关于应答器的东西。
>我的似乎没问题，状态完美……
>撞上OKLG，然后死了……
>当我意识到自己还和另一艘飞船对接时的表情……

observations.evidence: Request docking but they tell me no...
observations.evidence_zh: 请求对接，但他们拒绝了我……
